## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI jobs can apply exclusions through the environment.

## Changes
The pull request adds and documents a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches filenames before archiving. It logs skipped paths in verbose mode and adds tests for parsing, filtering, and archive contents.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the CLI archives `skip.log` because the parser defaults to an empty list. The flag reference requires new flags to “take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (`.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5`). — CI jobs that set exclusions through the environment produce archives containing files they intended to skip.

## Suggestions
- cli/main.py:33 — tests — Test exact-name exclusions in nested directories — The tests use only top-level files, so they would pass if `--exclude skip.log` stopped excluding `nested/skip.log` after a switch to matching relative paths. — A regression in basename matching could let nested files into archives without failing the tests.
